game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Magma Forge Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge, a forge fed by magma: the ash ranger must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before fire sprites spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge: a forge fed by magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Magma Forge, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before fire sprites spring the trap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the summit beacon using at most 11 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 11.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 11 before the summit beacon is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Magma Forge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The summit beacon reached with actions_used <= 11.
